title: New Mutants #95 Marvel 1990 X-tinction Agenda Part 2 Death of Warlock Liefeld
conditionDescription: Bright and clean with light handling wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
The New Mutants #95 (November 1990), Marvel Comics - X-tinction Agenda part 2, "First Blood." Death of Warlock. Rob Liefeld cover with Rahne Sinclair (Wolfsbane). Cable, Cannonball, Boom-Boom and the New Mutants vs. Genosha. $1.00 cover price.

Back cover: TSR Dungeon! board game ad.

Condition: bright and clean with light handling wear (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
